title: Other Ways to Say Sorry in English: 15 Better Phrases (With Examples)
description:
Other ways to say sorry in English: 15 better phrases for everyday life and for work. You get quick phrases for a small mistake, stronger phrases for a real apology, and professional phrases for work and emails. Every phrase comes with a picture, a clear meaning and a short example. After each set of five, you test yourself with a quick quiz and practise speaking by repeating the phrases out loud after me.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:13 A small mistake
1:11 Speaking practice: a small mistake
1:37 A real apology
2:46 Speaking practice: a real apology
3:17 At work
4:22 Speaking practice: at work

The 15 phrases
A small mistake: my bad, sorry about that, my mistake, excuse me, pardon me
A real apology: I am so sorry, that was my fault, I owe you an apology, please forgive me, I feel terrible
At work: I apologise, my apologies, sorry for the delay, I take full responsibility, please accept my apologies

Which phrase will you use next time? Write it in the comments.
